newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE wheat, barley futures rally as shippers buy.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE wheat, barley futures rally as shippers buy.

text.p: LIFFE wheat and barley futures rallied today on shipper buying, traders said.
Some short covering as sterling slipped against other European currencies contributed to the rally, they said.

Buying by shippers, frustrated by the shortage of physical market sellers, was on deferred months, as well as front month January, traders said. Traders noted the widening of Jan-Mar and Jan-May spreads.

Most active month, and the biggest riser, was May, up 1.40 stg to 98.85 stg per tonne, with volume of 105 lots. Front month Jan was up 1.10 stg to 94.85 on 43 lots. Mar last traded 1.20 stg higher at 97.00 stg, with 25 lots done.
Barley also rallied, with Jan and May the biggest risers. Both were last traded 1.25 stg up, Jan to 93.75 stg on 5 lots and May to 96.25 stg on 9 lots. Total barley volume was 33 lots.
The London International Fiinancial Futures Exchange is looking at ways of giving its wheat contract a more pan-European appeal, its chief executive Daniel Hodson told Reuters.
But no conclusions had been reached. "All bets are still on," Hodson said.
